:::{#sol-cross-product-sum-outer-practice}

By @thm-cross-product-sum-outer,

$$
\tprod{\matr{A}}{\matr{B}}
= \sbmat{1 \\ 2} \sbmat{3} + \sbmat{0 \\ 1} \sbmat{1}
= \sbmat{3 \\ 6} + \sbmat{0 \\ 1}
= \sbmat{3 \\ 7}.
$$

Multiplying directly gives the same:
$\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{B} = (1 \cd 3 + 0 \cd 1,\; 2 \cd 3 + 1 \cd 1) = (3, 7)$.

:::
